options.content:
### Tools & Edits
Use this dashboard when a session feels stuck or a tool seems unreliable. The **canary row** carries tool-execution health signals built only on telemetry that is actually populated: failure rate (success=false ≈ 3%), success rate, P95 tool duration, and edit-discipline ratios (Read per Edit/Write, Write share). The **funnel table** shows where work stops (decision → execution → success), **Failed Tool Runs** lists the real `error` text, and **Repeated File Edits** flags files rewritten many times. Code-edit language stats come from Prometheus and are **account-level** (no session/prompt scope).

_Note: this build has a single user (`user_email` always `unknown`, so no User filter). `decision_source` only ever takes `config` or `user_temporary` here — there is no user_abort/user_reject signal, so no abort/reject panel._

panels.title: Total Executions

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: How many tool_result events ran in the current scope.

panels.title: Tool Failure Rate

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | success = `false` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` [$__range])) * 100) or vector(0)

panels.description: Share of tool_result events with success=false. The real reliability canary (baseline ≈ 2.6%).

panels.title: Success Rate

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | success = `true` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` [$__range])) * 100) or vector(0)

panels.description: Share of tool_result events with success=true. Fastest way to answer “did it fail?”

panels.title: P95 Tool Duration

targets.expr: max(quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | unwrap duration_ms [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: 95th percentile tool_result duration_ms. With one stream per service this is the service p95 (max collapses multiple services to the worst). Fastest way to answer “was it slow?”

panels.title: Read per Edit/Write

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name = `Read` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name =~ `Edit|Write` [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.description: Read executions per Edit/Write. Low values suggest the model is editing before it has read enough context.

panels.title: Write Share

targets.expr: ((sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name = `Write` [$__range])) / sum(count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name =~ `Edit|Write` [$__range]))) * 100) or vector(0)

panels.description: Write as a share of all Edit/Write executions. A high Write share can indicate rewrite-heavy behavior instead of targeted edits.

panels.title: Execution Count by Tool

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` [$__interval]))

panels.description: Tool execution volume by tool over time. Look for execution bursts before drilling into individual runs.

panels.title: Failures by Tool

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | success = `false` [$__interval]))

panels.description: Failed tool executions (success=false) by tool over time. Spikes point to a specific failing tool.

panels.title: Decision → Execution → Success Funnel by Tool

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_decision` [$__range]))
sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` [$__range]))

sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | success = `true` [$__range]))

sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` | success = `false` [$__range]))

panels.description: Where tool work stops: decisions (tool_decision) vs executions (tool_result) vs success vs failures, per tool. Click a tool to scope the dashboard.

panels.title: Failed Tool Runs
panels.description: Every tool_result with success=false, showing the real `error` text. Sort by Duration or Time to triage the worst failures. Click a Session/Prompt to open Entity Detail.

panels.title: Repeated File Edits

targets.expr: sum by (file) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name =~ `Edit|Write` | line_format `{{.tool_input}}` | regexp `"file_path":\s*"(?P<file>[^"]+)"` [$__range]))

panels.description: Files edited/written more than once in scope, parsed from tool_input file_path. Repeated rewrites of one file can signal churn. Use the Edit Count filter (>1) to focus on hotspots.

panels.title: Edit/Write Count by Tool (fallback)

targets.expr: sum by (tool_name) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | event_name = `tool_result` | tool_name =~ `Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit` [$__range]))

panels.description: Per-tool edit volume. Kept as a simple companion to Repeated File Edits in case the file_path parse returns nothing for the current scope.

panels.title: Code Edit Decisions by Language (account-level)
panels.description: Code edits split by language and decision (Prometheus claude_code_code_edit_tool_decision_total). Only decision=accept is emitted by this build. This metric has no session/prompt scope, so it is account-level and ignores the Session/Prompt/Tool filters.

panels.title: Code Edit Decisions by Tool (account-level)
panels.description: Code edits split by edit tool (Prometheus). Account-level: no session/prompt scope.

panels.title: Decision Source Mix

targets.expr: sum by (decision_source) (count_over_time({service_name=~"$service"} | session_id=~"$session_id" | prompt_id=~"$prompt_id" | tool_name=~"$tool_name" | event_name = `tool_result` [$__range]))

panels.description: How tool executions were approved: config (auto-approved) vs user_temporary (a one-time user grant). Only these two values appear in this build.

panels.title: Tool Result Detail
panels.description: Single raw tool_result feed (replaces the two duplicate raw tables). Columns: Time, Tool, Success, Error, Duration, Decision Source, Prompt, Session. Click a Session/Prompt to open Entity Detail.
